summary: The bad() entry point gated IO.writeLine on IO.staticTrue, a non-final static that is only ever assigned true, so the condition is an expression that is always true (CWE-571). Replaced the always-true static read with IO.staticReturnsTrueOrFalse(), a runtime-evaluated predicate, so the guard can genuinely be true or false while the legitimate behavior (printing the line when the condition holds) is preserved.
